summary: Polar sweep ordering gives an angular sequence of CVRP customers around the depot.
description: Input is a list of planar coordinates with depot index zero and a start angle in radians. Return every customer in angular order relative to that cut.
Sort by wrapped polar angle and by customer index at ties. The result is a geometric ordering component. Capacity splitting and routing are separate operations. Sorting takes O(n log n) time.
